---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Feature Description**
Clearly describe the problem you want to solve or the capability to add.

**Use Case**
In what scenario is this feature needed?

**Implementation Suggestion (optional)**
How you expect it to be implemented or configured.

**Notes**
Osmium is a single-implementation project (Rust); new features should follow the existing project conventions.
